title: Reels
drop_hint: Drop in one long video or several short clips
merge_note: Clips are merged first, then the best moments are picked.
one_note: The best moments are picked from the long video.
music_note: Music replaces the original video audio.
ai_hint: Analyzes frames and recommends a preset
look_note: The preset is applied as an editable step when opened in the Editor.
highlights_skipped: Cut skipped — using the whole video
short_video: Video is shorter than target — using it whole
whole_video: Whole mode — video is not shortened
mode_strop_note: Ceiling-mounted camera: cuts out manipulation (placing/lifting), keeps stable segments.
mode_high_note: Best moments by motion and audio.
mode_whole_note: No shortening — just joining and adjustments.
margin_note: Extra seconds trimmed at each end of a stable segment.
no_segments: no stable segment — using whole clip
strop_hint: Stable segments are picked from each clip (without camera handling) and joined.
